name: reward-general-bench
description: A collection designed to evaluate reward models / preference models across a variety of text generation settings. It measures how well automatic reward scorers agree with human preferences or reference rankings, typically via pairwise comparisons and ranking tasks. Useful for assessing reward-model alignment and ranking consistency across generations.
evaluation_method: Preference agreement / pairwise accuracy and correlation with human judgments
reputation: A community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face used by a small group of researchers experimenting with reward-model evaluation; limited mainstream adoption.
